data.name: MythicTale
data.detailed_description:
MythicTale is a stylized top-down Action RPG where fast martial-arts combat, energy-powered abilities, exploration, and platforming come together in a vibrant 2.5D world inspired by classic handheld-era adventures.

Battle strange creatures, rival fighters, and powerful bosses as you journey through lively towns, dangerous wild zones, and handcrafted locations full of secrets. Build momentum through quick movement, precise timing, and combo-driven encounters, then unleash powerful energy techniques as you grow stronger with every challenge.

Beyond combat, explore the world at your own pace, tackle traversal and platforming challenges, meet memorable characters, and uncover the lore that ties the adventure together.

Features

FAST MARTIAL-ARTS COMBAT
Engage in responsive melee battles against creatures, rivals, and bosses with fluid movement, energy-infused attacks, and combo-driven action.

EXPLORE A VIBRANT 2.5D WORLD
Discover towns, wild zones, and handcrafted environments filled with quests, characters, secrets, and hidden paths.

UNLEASH POWERFUL ENERGY ABILITIES
Charge your aura, unleash devastating techniques, and develop your strength as you rise to face greater threats.

OVERCOME PLATFORMING AND TRAVERSAL TRIALS
Jump, climb, and navigate layered environments that add movement, challenge, and variety to your adventure.

data.short_description: Battle rivals, unleash energy attacks, explore dangerous zones, and take on platforming challenges as you fight to rise through the Super Fighter League in a 2.5D pixel-art action RPG.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 6500
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 (2GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 15 (Sequoia)
  • Processor: Apple Silicon (M1 or newer)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple Silicon integrated GPU (Metal)
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires Apple Silicon
